summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A., the Brazilian bank, furnished a Form 6-K containing its Management Discussion & Analysis and condensed parent-company and consolidated financial statements under BRGAAP for the third quarter of 2026, an equivalent of a US quarterly earnings report. No transaction is announced: the filing reports recurring managerial result of R$12.6bn for 3Q26, annualized recurring return on average equity of 23.6%, and operating revenues of R$49.2bn. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are present. This is routine periodic disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle exists.
